slice.name: divergent_duplicate_and_interrupted_append_probe
slice.purpose: Extend the existing hash-chained replay primitive with one divergent event_id reuse and one simulated interrupted append, then verify conflict rejection and restart from the last committed digest without partial application.

mechanism_extension.commit_framing: Canonical-JSON newline-delimited frames. A frame carries prev_chain, event, event_payload_digest, and commit_digest=SHA256(canonical envelope). Only complete newline-terminated frames are committed.
mechanism_extension.duplicate_guard: event_id is bound to the SHA-256 digest of its canonical event payload. Same id+same digest is idempotent; same id+different digest is rejected before commit.
mechanism_extension.interruption_recovery: On restart, replay only complete newline-terminated frames with valid payload digest, commit digest, and prev_chain. Trailing partial bytes remain unapplied.

slice.tested_scope: Deterministic small text state and a single-writer append boundary. This validates divergent duplicate rejection plus crash-style trailing-partial recovery for the framed journal. It does not yet establish concurrent multi-writer correctness, semantic model-weight adaptation, or indefinite repository availability.

zero_dependency_assessment.transport_note: Repository contents API is lightweight transport only. The tested adaptation/replay logic is deterministic Chat-local computation. A transport rate-limit or transient error is handled by durable checkpoint and next-invocation continuation, not same-run wait/retry; optional hosted compute/storage credits are not required.

slice.conflict_check: No O/O-derived, downstream, other-worker, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, or legacy semantic input was consumed. No protected-primary or scheduler mutation occurred. Only current instruction controls, own role-local state, and deterministic local probe logic were used.

exact_continuation: Next invocation: extend the same framed hash-chain with a two-writer stale-prev_chain race. Starting from one shared committed digest, construct two distinct complete candidate frames; accept one, verify the second is rejected solely because its prev_chain is stale and leaves state unchanged, then persist the exact stale-writer conflict evidence. Do not start any unrelated base-work leaf.
